changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.37[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Play an NZB[/COLOR]
-New: Play an NZB, in Movies and in TV Shows (it can be hidden in Settings > Navigation). Pick a .nzb or .nzb.gz from this device, a USB drive or a network share, or send it from your phone or computer by scanning the QR code on the TV. It plays at once with your Easynews account, with nothing downloaded first.
-New: "Play this NZB" in Kodi's context menu on any .nzb file.
-New: Played lately lists the last 12 NZBs you played, with their poster, and opens them again with one click. "Remove from this list" takes one away.
-The title is looked up on TMDb, so it plays with its poster and details and counts for Trakt and resume. A season pack asks which episode to play.
-Only films, TV shows and documentaries play. Music, games, programs or documents get a short notice, and adult content does not play while the Adult Content Filter is on (now shown in Settings > Usenet).
[COLOR fffdb515]Usenet: more releases play[/COLOR]
-New: password-protected 7z and RAR releases (RAR5 and RAR4, also with hidden file names) play with the password inside the NZB, decrypted while they play, seeking included. It needs the optional add-on PyCryptodome; Kodi offers to install it the first time.
-New: whole Blu-ray discs, in a folder or as an ISO image, loose or inside RAR and 7z: luc_kodi reads the disc's playlists, picks the film by its length on TMDb and plays all its pieces as one film, with the right length, seeking, resume and the Trakt watched mark. Disc releases now show up in the results, marked DISC.
-New: RAR sets with several files inside are read as a whole: a .nfo, sample or extras placed first no longer hide the film, and a season pack in one RAR set plays the episode you asked for.
-Fixed: 7z releases split with a smaller first piece, RAR and 7z pieces renamed to plain numbers or out of order, and NZB files that list the same post several times were refused although nothing was missing. They play now.
-DVD discs and DVD images are reported as such, and releases luc_kodi cannot open now say why instead of "removed from Easynews".
[COLOR fffdb515]Usenet: a quicker, steadier engine[/COLOR]
-New: a piece missing from Easynews is taken from another posting of the same release, after checking byte for byte that it is the same file.
-New: when a piece of an MKV film cannot be found anywhere, the player skips the gap cleanly (an EBML Void) instead of a broken picture.
-Quicker seeking and resuming, above all on Blu-ray discs and releases posted in big pieces, and on slow lines. While Kodi looks for the point to resume, the film's fanart covers the black screen, for every source.
-A stuck piece is asked for on a second connection after a time that fits the release (3 to 12 s), so the line is not spent on copies.
-Logged-in connections are handed on to the next release, NZB files are downloaded compressed, and releases you stop watching give back their memory. Opening a whole disc inside a RAR set keeps far less in memory.
-Only one notice at a time while luc_kodi moves on to the next NZB, and all of them go away when the video starts.
[COLOR fffdb515]Search[/COLOR]
-Fixed: some series are numbered differently on TMDb, TheTVDB and in the release names (The A-Team S03E08 played another episode). A release whose name carries the title of another episode is now left out.
-Fixed: a film that shares its title with a long series (Supergirl, 2026) found nothing on Easynews web search. The search is repeated with the year when the title alone fills the answer.
-Fixed: titles with an ellipsis or with the Spanish opening question and exclamation marks (Quieres ser mi... hijo?, 2023) found nothing on Easynews and Newznab. Those signs are now left out of the search.
-Usenet results already checked on Easynews come first, so the first one (and the one Auto-Play picks) starts. The source list is quicker on season packs.
-kodi.log says, for each Newznab indexer, how many results it gave and why the rest were left out.
-Fixed: when Easynews web search answered slowly, the search ran to its 25-second limit and lost every Easynews result (Zootopia 2). Now each Easynews search has a shorter limit, the search with the year is only made when the first one was quick, and a search that fails never takes away what was already found.
[COLOR fffdb515]One playback at a time[/COLOR]
-Fixed: when a source did not play, the search for the next one went on in the background even after you had started the film again from another search, and could replace it. Now the last playback you start is the one that counts.
-Closing the "Resolving" window stops the search for the next source. After 3 slow Easynews web links in a row, the rest are skipped and the Usenet releases are still tried.
[COLOR fffdb515]Under the hood[/COLOR]
-Errors in the background service no longer hide Kodi's shutdown request, and a few texts are spelled right (Reuse Language Invoker, Premiumize.me, successfully).
